content: better-sqlite3: enable WAL via db.pragma('journal_mode = WAL') immediately after opening; set a busy timeout either via the constructor option {timeout: 5000} or PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000 so lock contention retries instead of throwing SQLITE_BUSY immediately. For writers, prefer starting write transactions with BEGIN IMMEDIATE (better-sqlite3's db.transaction() defaults appropriately) rather than upgrading a read transaction to a write, which is a common source of SQLITE_BUSY even with a timeout set.
